title: Senior Payroll Officer
description:
Join Our Team as a Senior Payroll Officer
Location:
Head Office
Department:
Accounting & Finance
Reports to:
Accounting Operations Manager
Direct Reports:
Payroll Assistant
National Development Bank is seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Payroll Officer to lead our payroll operations. This is a fantastic opportunity for a seasoned payroll professional to contribute to a dynamic team and ensure the integrity and efficiency of our payroll systems.
Key Responsibilities:
Oversee and manage end-to-end payroll processing for all NDB employees.
Ensure compliance with tax regulations, statutory requirements, and internal policies.
Supervise payroll transactions including salary adjustments, deductions, and benefits.
Maintain accurate and confidential payroll records.
Reconcile payroll accounts and prepare financial reports.
Liaise with HR, Finance, and external bodies such as tax authorities and auditors.
Address payroll-related inquiries and resolve discrepancies proactively.
Ensure timely remittance of statutory deductions and manual payments.
Support year-end reporting and audits.
What We’re Looking For:
Education:
Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Accounting, or a related field.
Experience:
Minimum 5 years in payroll administration, with at least 2 years in a senior or supervisory role.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in Chris21 Payroll System or similar software
Advanced Excel skills
Strong knowledge of general ledger reconciliation and financial reporting
Soft Skills:
Excellent organizational and time management skills
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Effective communication and interpersonal abilities
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information
